0022600041.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (7-3, 5-1 on the road, third in the Northwest and 0.5 games back) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-10, four straight losses, 14th in the West) in a West Group C Emirates NBA Cup game, Portland's 12th of the season. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and a game-time decision. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-120 win in Sacramento on October 23, and the Trail Blazers won all four meetings in 2025-26.
